scope: Offline text templates for source-traced Core readable Markdown, including diagnostic, combined practice evidence and personal pilot candidate wording; not a replacement for the canonical app.js export.

skillsBoundary.sourceFragment: 這些是指定棋形的練習紀錄，不是獨立保留題或實戰成效。只把每次題目首次、未提示的作答列為可比較機會。
skillsBoundary.text: These are practice records from specified board positions, not independent retention checks or evidence of improved game performance. Only each question's first, unhinted response counts as a comparable opportunity.

skillsRow.sourceFragment: 可比較機會 ${eligible.length} 次；第一次作答正確 ${correct} 次。
skillsRow.text: - {skill}: {eligible} eligible first unhinted opportunities; {correct} correct first responses.

diagnosticsEmpty.sourceFragment: 尚無可比較的未提示首答。
diagnosticsEmpty.text: - No comparable first responses without hints have been recorded.

diagnosticsExcluded.sourceFragment: 未納入診斷的提示後或資格不明作答：
diagnosticsExcluded.text: - Excluded from this diagnostic (hinted, eligibility-unknown, or otherwise ineligible lesson/scheduler responses): {count}. These records remain available for other reporting denominators.

eventTableHeader.sourceFragment: | 時間 | 技能 | 題目 | 事件 | 條件 | 結果 | 經過時間 |
eventTableHeader.text: | Time | Skill | Item | Event | Condition | Outcome | Elapsed |

practiceBoundary.sourceFragment: 這些只作練習紀錄，不會直接改變能力紀錄、複習安排或正式評量。
practiceBoundary.text: These are practice records only. They do not directly alter the learner model, review schedule or formal evaluation.

practiceReadError.text: - ERROR: Practice event stream could not be read ({reason}); no values have been guessed.

liveEligible.sourceFragment: 符合目前觀察條件的局部機會：
liveEligible.text: - Local opportunities meeting the current eligibility criteria: {count}

liveSkillRow.text: - {skill}: eligible {eligible}; first responses {first}; satisfied {satisfied}; not satisfied {unsatisfied}; unanswered {unanswered}; state {state}.

liveReadError.text: - ERROR: Live evidence could not be read ({reason}); no replacement values have been inferred.

integratedCollection.text: - Live data collection: {status}; inspected {inspected}; eligible {eligible}; first responses {first}; unanswered {unanswered}; distinct sessions with first responses {sessions}.

integratedSkill.text: - {skill}: {practice} comparable practice opportunities; {delayed} completed delayed T2 cycles; {live} eligible live opportunities; {satisfied}/{first} satisfactory first live responses; next evidence needed: {next}.

trialApplication.text: - Position-application practice: {correct}/{total} correct; presented {presented}; unanswered/interrupted {unanswered}; inappropriate uses {inappropriate}; hinted or repeated excluded {excluded}.

sgfBoundary.sourceFragment: 以下是原局著手重建，不能單獨證明實戰改善；原判斷僅供日後人工復盤。
sgfBoundary.text: This reconstructs a move from a game record. It does not, on its own, establish improved game performance. Initial judgements are saved for later human review.

sgfOpponent.sourceFragment: 我預期對方會怎麼應手：

sgfEvidence.sourceFragment: 經確認的可接受答案或分析依據：

sgfNext.sourceFragment: 下一次看到相似局面時的提醒：

observationOne.text: - How I first thought about this:

diagnosticBoundary.text: These diagnostics classify observable responses to specified skill tasks. They do not establish a psychological or cognitive cause. A completed correction-distance sample requires separate unhinted, non-holdout delayed T2 first responses.

diagnosticNoError.text: - {skill}: {opportunities} comparable opportunities; no observed first-response errors.

diagnosticAwaitFirst.text: After the latest error: {count} comparable opportunities; awaiting the first eligible delayed review.

diagnosticAwaitSecond.text: After the latest error: {count} comparable opportunities; awaiting the second eligible delayed review.

diagnosticCompleted.sourceFragment: 次完成的穩定修正距離樣本
diagnosticCompleted.text: Completed correction-distance samples: {count}. This is diagnostic evidence only.

diagnosticNoSample.sourceFragment: 尚無可完成的穩定修正距離樣本
diagnosticNoSample.text: No completed correction-distance sample is available.

diagnosticLowerBound.text: Lower bound without an observed recurrence: {count} successful opportunities.

diagnosticUnclassified.text: Unclassified observable skill outcome ({id}); no specific diagnosis can be inferred.

integratedUnknown.text: UNKNOWN: Combined practice evidence could not be verified. No combined progress result is inferred.

integratedError.text: ERROR: Combined practice evidence could not be read ({reason}); no combined result is inferred.

integratedNoMastery.text: Combined records describe observed practice, delayed review and live opportunities; they do not certify mastery or a playing rank.

trialPilotBoundary.text: This is a personal usability and data-pipeline pilot. The questions were previously exposed during an older self-review and are not formal unseen items. These observations cannot establish learning gains, retention, transfer, causation or generalisation.

trialProtocolBoundary.text: The two batches test data handling, return flow and task burden. Previously exposed items cannot support formal unseen evaluation or claims of improvement, retention, transfer, causality, effects on other learners or permanent mastery.

trialBatch.text: - {role} batch: {correct}/{total} correct recorded first responses (descriptive only).

trialNoBatches.text: Insufficient pilot data: the baseline and seven-day follow-up are not both complete.

trialTwoBatches.sourceFragment: 兩批描述完成，仍屬資料不足
trialTwoBatches.text: Both pilot batches have descriptions, but the evidence remains insufficient for an effectiveness claim.

trialUnverifiedStatus.text: Insufficient data; no formal evaluation or learning-gain conclusion.

diagnosticPolicy.text: - Diagnostic metric policy: {version}. These observations are not a mastery estimate.

diagnosticHistorical.text: - Previously completed delayed correction-distance samples: {count}. A newer error may still be awaiting follow-up.

trialProtocol.text: - Personal pilot protocol: {id}; descriptive use only, formal unseen evaluation unavailable.

trialExposure.text: - Exposure: these pilot questions were previously seen in the R1 self-review. Neither batch is an unseen evaluation.

blocked: Full English readable export not activated; no output without an approved all-site locale and line-by-line evidence audit.
Diagnostics.interpretationBoundary, trial summary, live skill names/states and user-entered notes must be context-reviewed before an English release.
Missing, unknown or storage/provider errors must remain errors, never rendered as verified success.
The personal trial is previously exposed and data_insufficient even when both batches have completed.
Diagnostic and integrated English output is partial preview only: no learner state changes and no validation of retention, transfer, rank, or mastery.
Output must be tested against independent canonical event and summary fixtures before runtime connection.
